## Summary

Xellence AI enables private, on-premises AI for small and mid-sized businesses
and puts it to work on everyday tasks. Your data stays yours, your costs stay
predictable, and your team gets more done.

---

## Sound familiar? What we hear from business owners

They want the benefits of AI, without the enterprise budget or the risk.

- "Our people already paste customer data into public AI tools."
  You can't see it, and you can't take it back.
- "AI bills keep growing, and I can't predict them."
  Every new hire and every new tool adds another fee.
- "We don't have an AI team, or the time to build one."
  You need results, not a new department.
- "There are hundreds of AI tools. Where do we start?"
  You need to know which tasks are worth automating first.
- "Our customers ask where their data goes."
  Contracts and industry rules demand a clear answer.
- "We tried AI once. It never stuck."
  Most AI tools never connect to your files, your systems, or the way your team works.

---

## Results, multiplied: the same team, many times the output

AI pays off most on the repetitive work that fills your team's day.

### Output per person
Drafting, summarizing, and routine answers take minutes, not hours.
Before: hours of paperwork. After: more time for customers.

### Speed to customers
Quotes and replies go out the same day, drafted from your own materials.
Before: customers wait days. After: same-day answers.

### Company know-how
Manuals, contracts, and past projects answer questions on the spot.
Before: knowledge in a few heads. After: answers in seconds.

### Value per dollar
One system serves the whole team, with no fee for each new hire.
Before: costs grow with every seat. After: one predictable cost.

No vague promises. We agree on the numbers up front, such as hours saved or response time, and measure them against your real work.

---

## Why on-premises: your AI, on your terms

Public AI is easy to start with and hard to control. Private AI puts you in charge.

| What matters        | Public AI subscriptions               | Private AI with Xellence                           |
|---------------------|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| Your data           | Sent to outside servers               | Stays on your premises                             |
| Cost                | Per user, per month, plus usage       | A system you own, with predictable costs           |
| Access              | Everyone signs up on their own        | You decide who uses what, and every use is logged  |
| Knows your business | Only what you upload to a third party | Connected privately to your documents and systems  |
| Internet outage     | Stops working                         | Keeps working                                      |
| Flexibility         | Locked to one provider                | Your choice of AI models, free to switch           |

Best of both: keep sensitive work in-house, and send routine tasks to cloud AI
under your rules.

## What we deliver: everything you need, from one partner

Planning, equipment, setup, and support, all handled for you.

1. AI Opportunity Assessment: we find where AI saves you the most, then give
   you a clear plan and a fixed quote.
2. Private AI, On Your Premises: a system sized for your team, ready to use
   from day one.
3. AI Assistants for Your Work: customer service, quotes, document review,
   and reporting, all drawing on your own documents.
4. Connected to Your Tools: email, files, CRM, ERP, and accounting, so AI works
   where your team already works.
5. Security & Access Control: sign in with company accounts, set permissions by
   role, and keep a record of every use.
6. Training & Support: hands-on training, ongoing support, and new uses whenever your team is ready.

## How it works: four steps, no surprises

1. Talk: an open conversation about your goals and where your team's time goes.
2. Plan: we choose the first tasks, size the system, and give you a fixed quote.
3. Set up: we set up and test everything on-site, then train your team.
4. Grow: we review results together and add new uses when you're ready.

---

## Questions owners ask

### How do you work with our IT team?
As partners. Your IT team stays in charge of your systems, and we bring the AI expertise, from setup to training and support. If you don't have an IT team, we take care of it all for you.

### Is my business big enough?
If several people spend their days on customers, documents, or reports, yes.
We size the system to your team.

### What does it cost?
It depends on your team and goals. After the assessment, you get a fixed quote
for equipment, setup, and support, with no per-seat fees.

### Is private AI as capable as public AI?
For everyday work like writing, summarizing, and searching documents, yes. When
a task needs more, non-sensitive work can go to a cloud service under your
rules.

### Will our data be used to train someone else's AI?
No. Your data stays on your equipment and is never shared without your permission.
